ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Cineline India Limited reported a net loss of Rs. 120.98 lakhs for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, despite achieving robust year-over-year revenue growth. This swing to a net loss was primarily driven by a material exceptional item of Rs. 154.19 lakhs, resulting from the derecognition of assets following a fire incident at one of its cinema premises. While an insurance claim has been lodged, the potential recovery is not yet recognized and remains a key factor impacting future financial outcomes.
